examples.name: Campus
examples.description: Three buildings and a site, each split into structure, architecture and services, over a shared library of types. One archive importing eleven.

examples.name: Campus, by discipline
examples.description: The same three buildings, with each discipline as its own tessera, so they can be shown and hidden separately.

examples.name: Boxes by type
examples.description: Parts whose geometry belongs to the type they are, rather than to them. Turn compose off and they disappear.
